description: Use when you have invoice data but no XML and need a Romanian e-Factura ANAF accepts: builds UBL 2.1 CIUS-RO XML from simple data (number, dates, seller and buyer CUI, lines with name, quantity, unit, price without VAT and VAT rate e.g. 21 or 11, optional IBAN). Company names, addresses, county codes, Bucharest sectors and VAT status come from ANAF; totals and VAT are computed; the XML is validated before it is returned. Paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only when a valid invoice is returned. Other currencies: add 'currency': 'EUR' (BNR rate used unless you pass exchange_rate). Example invoice: {"number": "FCT-0001", "issue_date": "2026-10-24", "due_date": "2026-11-23", "seller": {"cui": "RO12345678"}, "buyer": {"cui": "87654321"}, "payment": {"iban": "RO49AAAA1B31007593840000"}, "lines": [{"name": "Servicii consultanta", "quantity": 10, "unit": "ore", "price": 150, "vat_rate": 21}]}
